In her childhood, she was creative and loved to do some plays. She loved cartoons and at one point, Nickelodeon depicted the behind the scenes in one of their cartoons, which gave her the initial idea of ​​becoming an animator.

She entered a private high school, which consisted of 200 students in total. The boys in her class didn't really like her, which demotivated Rebecca and made her more introverted.

Later, when she reached high school, where she developed major self-esteem and anxiety issues, she was bullied a lot. Also, she was harassed for her plump body.

After dropping her classes, she felt relieved and happier. She also had more time to herself and spent a lot of time on the internet, mostly for fanart. She created her YouTube channel in April 2006 under the name "grizabella626", then it was called "Rebecca Parham's Second Channel", and then back to "grizabella626".

She was accepted into her local private college. Initially, she chose to major in drama and choir. However, a year later, she talked to her parents about changing careers from drama to animation. Rebecca showed her drawing skills to her parents, which convinced her father to send her to Ringling College of Art and Design.

She visited the campus and initially her portfolio was rejected by Ringling's advisor, so she decided to recreate her entire portfolio and then send it to Ringling. A few months later, she was accepted to the university.

She rediscovered YouTube and the creators on the platform, including Dane Boe, who eventually befriended her. She herself held onto the idea of ​​becoming a YouTube animator or YouTuber, even though people who choose the career of computer animation are supposed to apply to big studios like Pixar and DreamWorks.

After graduating, she planned to return home to Texas, rework her portfolio, and apply to major animation studios. However, her family encouraged her to go into business herself, under the name "Let Me Explain Studios." Her new YouTube channel was created in February 2014.

Despite creating her own business, she felt very anxious about her near future and very undecided about what she should do, whether to apply to an animation studio or create her own business.

Also, in the same year, her father died on November 18, 2014, due to a heart attack. Losing him taught her that when someone lives through something they previously thought they couldn't survive and it turns out okay, the world from their perspective doesn't seem scary anymore, and they could always be much stronger than they think.

Despite her dark times, she continued to run her company by continuously working on YouTube videos. She received twenty thousand subscribers 2 and a half years later and became friends with other YouTube creators including TimTom, Jaiden Animations, and more. Additionally, he worked on "How to Scare Your Favorite YouTubers at Conventions" which was released on May 5th, 2017, and ever since the video was posted, his subscriber count has increased dramatically, reaching 100k subscribers the night before he flew into VidCon. In July of 2017, he officially became a full-time YouTuber, and has since continued to upload videos for his fans and gain subscribers.
